detail.title: Epistemic Thresholds for Question Abandonment
detail.summary: This notebook synthesizes evidence on the structural conditions under which an intelligent system should abandon a research question. It establishes that abandonment is not merely a failure of persistence, but an epistemic necessity when the persistence of a structure (e.g., a research agenda) loses coherence against emerging data, or when the system identifies that its current inquiry path has become indistinguishable from the absence of knowledge.
